_comment: The discs: freely licensed DVD-Video images on archive.org, in the order of the site's shelf. Discs with the same title (a film's PAL and NTSC discs, or the discs of a set) stack in one place on the shelf, told apart by `system` and, for a set, `part`. `credit` is the attribution the disc's licence asks for. scripts/fetch_discs.py fetches `image` from the archive.org item `archive_id`. `menu` holds `menuseum render` options (inputs, NAV packs to settle) for discs whose first menu isn't the one their label's colours are sampled from (scripts/looks.py).

discs.title: Sita Sings the Blues
discs.blurb: Nina Paley's animated Ramayana, set to 1920s jazz recordings.
discs.notes: .img not browsable on archive.org; fetched via HTTP range reads of the ISO 9660 filesystem. The upload carries no licence tag; the film is CC BY-SA 3.0 (later CC0).

discs.title: Elephants Dream
discs.credit: Orange Open Movie Project, Blender Foundation and Netherlands Media Art Institute
discs.blurb: The official disc of the first Blender open movie. Nine title sets and a long motion menu.
discs.notes: 9 VTSs; VTS_01_0.VOB is a ~180 MB motion menu. The upload carries no licence tag; the film is CC BY 2.5.

discs.title: Elephants Dream
discs.credit: Orange Open Movie Project, Blender Foundation and Netherlands Media Art Institute
discs.blurb: The NTSC disc of the official release.
discs.notes: 8 VTSs; NTSC counterpart of disc 1. The upload carries no licence tag; the film is CC BY 2.5.

discs.title: Big Buck Bunny
discs.blurb: The official disc of Peach, the second Blender open movie. Eleven title sets behind a motion menu.
discs.notes: 11 VTSs; PAL counterpart, ~78 MB motion menu. The film's CC BY 3.0 covers everything on the DVDs.

discs.title: Big Buck Bunny
discs.blurb: The NTSC disc of the official release.
discs.notes: Professionally authored; 14 VTSs; VTS_01_0.VOB is an ~82 MB motion menu. The film's CC BY 3.0 covers everything on the DVDs.

discs.title: Sintel
discs.blurb: The film disc from the box set of Durian, the third Blender open movie.
discs.notes: 7 VTSs; ~86 MB motion menu. The box's EXTRAS and DATA discs aren't DVD-Video. The upload is tagged CC BY 4.0; the film is CC BY 3.0.

discs.title: Sintel
discs.blurb: The NTSC film disc from the box set.
discs.notes: 7 VTSs; NTSC counterpart, ~92 MB motion menu. The upload is tagged CC BY 4.0; the film is CC BY 3.0.

discs.title: Nina Vision
discs.blurb: Six short films by Nina Paley. Authored by hand by Terry Hancock, with a looping motion menu.
discs.notes: Hand-authored by Terry Hancock; 125 MB looping VMGM motion menu.

discs.title: Valkaama
discs.blurb: An open-source feature film: a road movie from Sweden to northern Finland.
discs.notes: 1 VTS; 28 MB menu VOB. The upload is tagged CC BY-SA 4.0; the film is CC BY-SA 3.0.

discs.title: BloodSpell
discs.blurb: Strange Company's machinima punk fantasy, made in Neverwinter Nights.
discs.notes: Uploaded by Strange Company; 3 VTSs, 22 MB menu VOB.

discs.title: BloodSpell
discs.blurb: The special edition's extras disc: seventeen title sets of making-of features, bloopers and more.
discs.notes: Extras disc; 17 VTSs with small menus, so lots of cross-VTS navigation.

discs.title: AV Calibration
discs.blurb: Test patterns and tones for setting up a TV and speakers.
discs.notes: No VIDEO_TS.VOB (VMGM has no menu VOBs); menus live in VTS_01_0.

discs.title: AV Calibration
discs.blurb: The NTSC version of the calibration disc.
